score_reasons.quality: Watercolor plus colored-pencil hand-drawn texture is convincing and consistent; all 12 food vignettes are cleanly rendered with credible materials (glaze on bowls, steam, sugar dusting); only the smallest handwritten caption lines show smudged pseudo-characters.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Delightful cohesive palette of bayberry red, ginger yellow, sea blue and green; balanced numbered layout over the pale map, unified vine/seafood border, chubby rounded title lettering; cute style held throughout without clutter.
score_reasons.alignment: Nearly complete delivery: bird's-eye simplified map base, region and water labels (椒江、路桥、黄岩、临海、三门、台州湾 etc.), all 12 required foods present with correct signature details — chopsticks pulling strands on 蛋清羊尾, ginger-vinegar dish beside the 三门青蟹, eight bowls in a circle for 仙居八大碗, blue-and-white bowl for 姜汁调蛋 — plus compass marked 东海, legend box, square 1:1 ratio, and the title 台州·山海食光地图 decorated with bayberry and fish. Shortfalls: several one-line recommendation quotes are garbled or semi-legible, and a couple of region labels are tiny and deformed.
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: Taizhou culinary culture is faithfully represented (三门青蟹, 石塘渔港海鲜面, 紫阳古街食饼筒 are real local icons); the non-scale cute map is per brief; compass direction 东海 is geographically correct; no cultural errors.
score_reasons.creative_generation: Imaginative fusion of story-map and food illustration with a numbered tasting route, clear information hierarchy between title, numbered items and map, and thoughtful framing decoration; execution is polished though the garbled micro-copy slightly undercuts the map's believability.

unfulfilled_requirements: Several handwritten recommendation-quote lines are garbled pseudo-characters (e.g., captions under 食饼筒 and 青蟹)
Legend box text only partially legible
Small region/water labels 椒江/灵江 slightly deformed
